facts.title: Atelier UI — Handcrafted React Animations & UI Components
facts.description: Atelier UI is a growing collection of quality web animations and creative tools, built with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Motion, and React Three Fiber.

research.name: Atelier UI
research.note: React animation registry of WebGL shaders and 3D galleries built with React Three Fiber and Motion.

effects: Orbit, Sphere and Spiral 3D image galleries

unverified: The free components are in the public repository whatisjery/atelier-ui (MIT); research that repository instead. The 14 pro-only components ($79.99 one-time) are presumably not in it.
Only the homepage hero was seen in a screenshot; the effect names come from the page text and component links.
